text: dsh-unarchive 是一个适用于 DSH 的会话管理插件，提供命令和 agent 工具两种入口。它通过读取工作区归档会话集合，并在支持时调用 workspaceRegistry 的恢复接口，或写入工作区存储，将会话从归档集合移除。用户可以查看归档会话及可用标题、按会话 ID 恢复会话，也可以在 agent 对话中请求列出或恢复。适合需要找回误归档会话的 DSH 用户。无需 API 密钥或额外账号；需安装到 profile。

dsh-unarchive restores archived DSH sessions through a command or agent tool. It lists archived IDs with available titles and restores a session by ID. It uses the workspace registry API when available, with a storage fallback. Install it in a DSH profile; no API key or account is required.

dsh-unarchive 的功能「查看归档会话」：显示当前归档集合中的会话 ID，并在可用时附上标题。可运行 /unarchive，或调用工具时省略 sessionId；没有归档项时会提示列表为空。
dsh-unarchive 的功能「按 ID 恢复会话」：从工作区归档集合移除指定会话 ID，使其重新出现在工作区。可向 /unarchive 传入 ID，或调用 unarchive_session 并提供 sessionId。
dsh-unarchive 的功能「兼容恢复接口」：优先使用 workspaceRegistry.unarchiveSession；接口不可用时，改写 workspace 存储中的归档 ID 集合。回退方式可能造成重启前缓存不同步。
dsh-unarchive 的功能「恢复时显示会话标题」：列出归档项时尝试从持久化列表和 projection cache 读取标题；数据不可用或读取失败时退回只显示会话 ID。
dsh-unarchive 在缺少核心恢复接口时会直接写 workspace 存储；注册表内存缓存可能到重启后才同步，重启前刷新界面或修改工作区可能再次隐藏该会话。

dsh-unarchive README · dsh-unarchive：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Restore archived sessions in the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Archiving a session hides it from every grouping surface (workspace groups, Ungrouped, flat list, search) but never deletes it. This plugin adds the missing inverse: two entry points that remove a session from the registry-global archive set so it reappears at its original position.

dsh-unarchive README · What you get：| Entry point | Where | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/unarchive` | GUI command palette (`/` menu) or any command surface | No argument lists the archived sessions (ids plus best-effort titles); a session id restores it |
| `unarchive_session` | Agent tools (any session) | Omitted `sessionId` lists the archived sessions; a `sessionId` restores one |

dsh-unarchive README · What you get：Both entry points restore the session live in every connected GUI client (`host/archived-sessions-changed`) and the change survives restarts. Session logs and workspace accounting slots are never touched.

dsh-unarchive README · Requirements：None beyond a stock DeepSeek Harness profile. The plugin is self-contained:

- On builds that ship `workspaceRegistry.unarchiveSession`, it uses that durable core API.
- Otherwise it writes the workspace domain's `archivedSessionIds` global directly — the same durable, live-updating data `archiveSession` reads and writes.

dsh-unarchive README · Requirements：**Self-contained caveat:** the direct-domain write leaves the workspace registry's in-memory cache stale until the next restart. Until then the session reappears live, but (a) refreshing the GUI re-hides it, and (b) a later archive/workspace change re-archives it. Restart dsh to fully settle it.

dsh-unarchive README · Install：As a profile bundle (recommended), from a checkout of this repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:edfrey0044/dsh-unarchive

dsh-unarchive README · or, after publishing to npm:：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-unarchive
```

Restart `dsh web` (or your profile). The bundle patch auto-joins the profile's layer stack because this package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`.

Manual composition: add the row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and install the package into the profile:yaml

dsh-unarchive README · ~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml (one insert over the profile root)：- insert:
    - id: dsh-unarchive
      name: dsh-unarchive
```

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<name>
pnpm add github:edfrey0044/dsh-unarchive
```

- session-b96a78f1-b6bf-439b-9570-c054307e6adb  (张雪峰视角：西财中外合作报考建议)

Or ask the agent in any session: *"把归档的会话恢复一下"* — the model calls `unarchive_session` for you.

dsh-unarchive README · Usage：Session ids also live on disk: `~/.dsh/sessions/<project>/<sessionId>/` (or `$DSH_HOME/sessions/...`), and the archive set itself is `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json` → `global.archivedSessionIds`.

dsh-unarchive README · How it works：Archiving keeps the session's `sessionIds` slot in the workspace account; only a display-set write moves the id into `archivedSessionIds`. Unarchiving is the inverse write, so the session resurfaces exactly where it was.

dsh-unarchive README · How it works：The plugin prefers the core API (`WorkspaceRegistry.unarchiveSession`) when the build ships it. On stock builds it writes the workspace domain's `archivedSessionIds` global directly via `ctx.storageDomain`; that write is durable and emits `domain/changed`, which the host turns into `host/archived-sessions-changed` for every connected client. The self-contained path's one limitation is the registry's in-memory cache (see Requirements).

dsh-unarchive README · Development：The implementation is plain ESM (`lib/index.js`) with hand-written declarations — no build step.

- `npm test` — stub-based unit tests (fake registries; no DSH boot).
- End-to-end verification against a real harness checkout: mount the plugin with real `storage-domain`/`workspaceRegistry` in a temp world and drive the captured command handler. See `tests/` for the scenario shape.
